comparison.objective: Adjusts a drum-brake star wheel through a slot until the drum has light drag; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2167 requires blind tooth engagement, levering, tool repositioning, and alternating adjustment with drum turning; the candidate requires concentric driver/wrench seating and opposing torque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2167 checks 22–28 clicks, light drag, no lockup, and tool release; the candidate checks a locked 90° opening retained across three cycles with limited drift.
comparison.reason: Functional verification is shared, but detented blind clearance adjustment lacks the candidate's separate jam-nut locking and setpoint-preserving countertorque.

review_notes: Drum-brake star-wheel adjustment then drag verification. Compare tool seating/regrasping and functional setting outcome; original notch and damping approximations are explicit.
